games.name: Project Slayers
games.desc:

Choose your path: protect humanity or embrace the darkness.
Your story… your fate. 😈

🖥️ [Default Controls]
M1 – Attack (Left Click)
M2 – Heavy Attack (Right Click)
M – Open Menu
Q – Dash
CTRL – Wall Climb
Left Shift – Sprint
Left Alt – Mouse Lock

🎮 [Combo Variations]
LRLRL or SPACE – Air Combo
RRLRL – Special Combo
LLRLR – Special Combo

games.name: Emergency Response Australia
games.desc:
🇦🇺 Welcome to Redgum Australia! An open-world driving and emergency responders roleplay experience.

🚗 Drive, explore & go off-road
Choose from a growing range of iconic Australian vehicles. Cruise around town, hit the back roads, or take your 4WD off-road outside Redgum.

🚔 Choose your side
Crime is causing chaos across town. Join the Police and help keep Redgum under control — or become the reason they're needed.

💰 Live the criminal life
Track down the criminal dealer hidden somewhere around the map and see what they've got in stock. Steal vehicles, rob stores, make money and escape the police before you're caught.

🔨 Update Log: 17/10/2026
⭐ Car Customisation 
You can now customise your vehicle with new types of license plates, colour it with premium paint styles, chance license plate text, add P plates, L plates or add tinted windows (light, dark, medium, dark, limo). This also saves on respawn!
📚  Added Tutorial
We've added a new tutorial for new players.

games.name: Retro Mechanics [BETA]
games.desc:
Welcome to Retro Mecanica!

This game takes you directly to the past, to the 1970s, in Argentina, where you will experience the mechanics of vehicles in their highest splendor. Buy used cars, restore them, resell them, race with them, visit the race track and break records!

Tracks aren't your thing? The drag strip is waiting for you, with the best racing you'll find!
What you want is high speed? You have the oval track at your disposal, where every lap is pedal to the metal!
Would you rather go quiet? You can simply repair a used car and stroll around the countryside.
